keyEvents.text: Goal! Real Madrid 1, Malaga 0. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the centre of the goal.
Own Goal by Alfonso Herrero, Malaga. Real Madrid 2, Malaga 0.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, Malaga 0. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Trent Alexander-Arnold with a cross.
Substitution, Malaga. Pablo Martínez replaces Rafa Rodríguez.
Second Half begins Real Madrid 3, Malaga 0.
Substitution, Malaga. José Salinas replaces Carlos Puga.
Substitution, Malaga. Juan Cruz replaces Joaquín Muñoz.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Yan Diomande replaces Brahim Díaz.
Chupe (Malaga) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Malaga. Haitam Abaida replaces Einar Galilea.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Bernardo Silva replaces Federico Valverde.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Arda Güler replaces Jude Bellingham.
Substitution, Malaga. Ramón Enríquez replaces Izan Merino.
Goal! Real Madrid 4, Malaga 0. Arda Güler (Real Madrid) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Vinícius Júnior following a fast break.
Ramón Enríquez (Malaga) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
